EV-000807

Packing 8 unit circles in the smallest square · Packing · status current

Definition

s(8) = the smallest side of a square that contains 8 non-overlapping circles of radius 1.

s(8)=\min\{s:\ 8\text{ disjoint open unit disks fit in }[0,s]^2\}

Domain: arrangements of unit disks in a square. Normalisation: side length of the square; circles have radius 1; a trailing '+' marks a decimal printed truncated (true value slightly larger). Direction: min.

Current value

5.863+ (exact)

Source: E. Friedman, Erich's Packing Center, Circles in Squares (page last modified 2026-10-09) https://erich-friedman.github.io/packing/cirinsqu/ 2026-10-09
